verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ كُلَّ جَمَاعَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ: تَكُونُونَ قِدِّيسِينَ لِأَنِّي قُدُّوسٌ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God [am] holy.
verses.web: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am holy.

verses.ar: تَهَابُونَ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ أُمَّهُ وَأَبَاهُ، وَتَحْفَظُونَ سُبُوتِي. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.web: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.

verses.ar: لَا تَلْتَفِتُوا إِلَى ٱلْأَوْثَانِ، وَآلِهَةً مَسْبُوكَةً لَا تَصْنَعُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.web: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.

verses.ar: وَمَتَى ذَبَحْتُمْ ذَبِيحَةَ سَلَامَةٍ لِلرَّبِّ فَلِلرِّضَا عَنْكُمْ تَذْبَحُونَهَا.
verses.kjv: ¶ And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
verses.web: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَذْبَحُونَهَا تُؤْكَلُ، وَفِي ٱلْغَدِ. وَٱلْفَاضِلُ إِلَى ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّالِثِ يُحْرَقُ بِٱلنَّارِ.
verses.kjv: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.web: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا أُكِلَتْ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّالِثِ فَذَلِكَ نَجَاسَةٌ لَا يُرْضَى بِهِ.
verses.kjv: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it [is] abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.web: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْهَا يَحْمِلُ ذَنْبَهُ لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ دَنَّسَ قُدْسَ ٱلرَّبِّ. فَتُقْطَعُ تِلْكَ ٱلنَّفْسُ مِنْ شَعْبِهَا.
verses.kjv: Therefore [every one] that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.web: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of Yahweh, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.ar: «وَعِنْدَمَا تَحْصُدُونَ حَصِيدَ أَرْضِكُمْ لَا تُكَمِّلْ زَوَايَا حَقْلِكَ فِي ٱلْحَصَادِ. وَلُقَاطَ حَصِيدِكَ لَا تَلْتَقِطْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verses.web: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

verses.ar: وَكَرْمَكَ لَا تُعَلِّلْهُ، وَنِثَارَ كَرْمِكَ لَا تَلْتَقِطْ. لِلْمِسْكِينِ وَٱلْغَرِيبِ تَتْرُكُهُ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather [every] grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.web: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.

verses.ar: «لَا تَسْرِقُوا، وَلَا تَكْذِبُوا، وَلَا تَغْدُرُوا أَحَدُكُمْ بِصَاحِبِهِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.web: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَحْلِفُوا بِٱسْمِي لِلْكَذِبِ، فَتُدَنِّسَ ٱسْمَ إِلَهِكَ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

verses.ar: «لَا تَغْصِبْ قَرِيبَكَ وَلَا تَسْلُبْ، وَلَا تَبِتْ أُجْرَةُ أَجِيرٍ عِنْدَكَ إِلَى ٱلْغَدِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob [him:] the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.web: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.

verses.ar: لَا تَشْتِمِ ٱلْأَصَمَّ، وَقُدَّامَ ٱلْأَعْمَى لَا تَجْعَلْ مَعْثَرَةً، بَلِ ٱخْشَ إِلَهَكَ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

verses.ar: لَا تَرْتَكِبُوا جَوْرًا فِي ٱلْقَضَاءِ. لَاتَأْخُذُوا بِوَجْهِ مِسْكِينٍ وَلَا تَحْتَرِمْ وَجْهَ كَبِيرٍ. بِٱلْعَدْلِ تَحْكُمُ لِقَرِيبِكَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: [but] in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.web: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

verses.ar: لَا تَسْعَ فِي ٱلْوِشَايَةِ بَيْنَ شَعْبِكَ. لَا تَقِفْ عَلَى دَمِ قَرِيبِكَ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt not go up and down [as] a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am Yahweh.

verses.ar: لَا تُبْغِضْ أَخَاكَ فِي قَلْبِكَ. إِنْذَارًا تُنْذِرُ صَاحِبَكَ، وَلَا تَحْمِلْ لِأَجْلِهِ خَطِيَّةً.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
verses.web: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

verses.ar: لَا تَنْتَقِمْ وَلَا تَحْقِدْ عَلَى أَبْنَاءِ شَعْبِكَ، بَلْ تُحِبُّ قَرِيبَكَ كَنَفْسِكَ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.

verses.ar: فَرَائِضِي تَحْفَظُونَ. لَا تُنَزِّ بَهَائِمَكَ جِنْسَيْنِ، وَحَقْلَكَ لَا تَزْرَعْ صِنْفَيْنِ، وَلَا يَكُنْ عَلَيْكَ ثَوْبٌ مُصَنَّفٌ مِنْ صِنْفَيْنِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
verses.web: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱضْطَجَعَ رَجُلٌ مَعَ ٱمْرَأَةٍ ٱضْطِجَاعَ زَرْعٍ وَهِيَ أَمَةٌ مَخْطُوبَةٌ لِرَجُلٍ، وَلَمْ تُفْدَ فِدَاءً وَلَا أُعْطِيَتْ حُرِّيَّتَهَا، فَلْيَكُنْ تَأْدِيبٌ. لَا يُقْتَلَا لِأَنَّهَا لَمْ تُعْتَقْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that [is] a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.web: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

verses.ar: وَيَأْتِي إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ بِذَبِيحَةٍ لِإِثْمِهِ إِلَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ: كَبْشًا، ذَبِيحَةَ إِثْمٍ.
verses.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, [even] a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.web: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

verses.ar: فَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِكَبْشِ ٱلْإِثْمِ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ مِنْ خَطِيَّتِهِ ٱلَّتِي أَخْطَأَ، فَيُصْفَحُ لَهُ عَنْ خَطِيَّتِهِ ٱلَّتِي أَخْطَأَ.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
verses.web: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahweh for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

verses.ar: «وَمَتَى دَخَلْتُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَغَرَسْتُمْ كُلَّ شَجَرَةٍ لِلطَّعَامِ، تَحْسِبُونَ ثَمَرَهَا غُرْلَتَهَا. ثَلَاثَ سِنِينَ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ غَلْفَاءَ. لَا يُؤْكَلْ مِنْهَا.
verses.kjv: ¶ And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.web: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلسَّنَةِ ٱلرَّابِعَةِ يَكُونُ كُلُّ ثَمَرِهَا قُدْسًا لِتَمْجِيدِ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD [withal].
verses.web: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to Yahweh.

verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلسَّنَةِ ٱلْخَامِسَةِ تَأْكُلُونَ ثَمَرَهَا، لِتَزِيدَ لَكُمْ غَلَّتَهَا. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.web: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.

verses.ar: «لَا تَأْكُلُوا بِٱلدَّمِ. لَا تَتَفَاءَلُوا وَلَا تَعِيفُوا.
verses.kjv: ¶ Ye shall not eat [any thing] with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.web: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

verses.ar: لَا تُقَصِّرُوا رُؤُوسَكُمْ مُسْتَدِيرًا، وَلَا تُفْسِدْ عَارِضَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.web: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَجْرَحُوا أَجْسَادَكُمْ لِمَيْتٍ. وَكِتَابَةَ وَسْمٍ لَا تَجْعَلُوا فِيكُمْ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.

verses.ar: لَا تُدَنِّسِ ٱبْنَتَكَ بِتَعْرِيضِهَا لِلزِّنَى لِئَلَّا تَزْنِيَ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَمْتَلِئَ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَذِيلَةً.
verses.kjv: ¶ Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.web: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

verses.ar: سُبُوتِي تَحْفَظُونَ، وَمَقْدِسِي تَهَابُونَ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.

verses.ar: لَا تَلْتَفِتُوا إِلَى ٱلْجَانِّ وَلَا تَطْلُبُوا ٱلتَّوَابِعَ، فَتَتَنَجَّسُوا بِهِمْ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.web: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.

verses.ar: مِنْ أَمَامِ ٱلْأَشْيَبِ تَقُومُ وَتَحْتَرِمُ وَجْهَ ٱلشَّيْخِ، وَتَخْشَى إِلَهَكَ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

verses.ar: «وَإِذَا نَزَلَ عِنْدَكَ غَرِيبٌ فِي أَرْضِكُمْ فَلَا تَظْلِمُوهُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
verses.web: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

verses.ar: كَٱلْوَطَنِيِّ مِنْكُمْ يَكُونُ لَكُمُ ٱلْغَرِيبُ ٱلنَّازِلُ عِنْدَكُمْ، وَتُحِبُّهُ كَنَفْسِكَ، لِأَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ غُرَبَاءَ فِي أَرْضِ مِصْرَ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ.
verses.kjv: [But] the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.web: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

verses.ar: لَا تَرْتَكِبُوا جَوْرًا فِي ٱلْقَضَاءِ، لَا فِي ٱلْقِيَاسِ، وَلَا فِي ٱلْوَزْنِ، وَلَا فِي ٱلْكَيْلِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.web: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

verses.ar: مِيزَانُ حَقٍّ، وَوَزْنَاتُ حَقٍّ، وَإِيفَةُ حَقٍّ، وَهِينُ حَقٍّ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ.
verses.kjv: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I [am] the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.web: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.ar: فَتَحْفَظُونَ كُلَّ فَرَائِضِي، وَكُلَّ أَحْكَامِي، وَتَعْمَلُونَهَا. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ».
verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’”
